Name: FadeHelm's Shannon anime style portrait
Author: FadeHelm
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
This mod adds five replacement portraits for Shannon, which are drawn in my style. I hope you like it. In addition, this mod is still not complete. It lacks SpiritsEve, because I don't know what Shannon played in that festival. If anyone knows, please let me know. I will draw it as soon as possible and release the updated content. Finally, if you like my portrait, could you give me an Endorsement?

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
I'd like to clarify this point especially for new players who have never installed any portrait replacement mods before: my mod only requires you to download two prerequisite mods and place my mod in the same folder as them—then you can launch the game and use it immediately！

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Here are two prerequisite mods I'd like to remind you about—don't miss either one. You might have already installed one of them, but some people may not know that installing the same mod multiple times can cause it to fail to run properly. This is not a bug in my mod.

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
特别感谢Szzrain大佬帮我编写了cp
也感谢sdvhead制作了这个有趣的模组
